paragraphs: Rav Chama bar Guria — [Shabbat 9a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.9a.3-4). Yehuda ben Guria (a Tanna) — [Eruvin 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.63a.18).

Rabbi Shmuel bar Guria — Tanchuma (the Old) on Behar (compare [Tanchuma, Behar 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tanchuma%2C_Behar.1.1)); and in the [Buber Tanchuma, Behar 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tanchuma_Buber%2C_Behar.2.1) the reading is Rav Shmuel bar Gedalya.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted standard Tanchuma gives Rabbi Shmuel bar Gurya, and the consulted Buber version gives R’ Shmuel ben Gedalya. Both introduce the same comparison of a Torah section to a column. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3384&lang=en) records a Gurya form and expresses uncertainty about the figure. The patronymics are kept as found in each witness.
